integration_diagnostics.bulk_retry_confirm_one: Requeue {{count}} {{statusLabel}} outbox event {{providerLabel}}? It will be picked up on the next drain cycle.

connector_health.title: Connector Health
connector_health.subtitle: Cross-tenant view of connectors that need a reconnect or are failing to sync, plus recent proactive token-refresh failures from the background sweep.
connector_health.stat_expiring_soon_title: Healthy connectors expiring in the next {{hours}}h
connector_health.stat_stuck_outbox_title: Outbox events parked in failed/dead_letter — see the Stuck connector messages panel below
connector_health.empty_reconnect: No connectors are flagged as needing a reconnect. All OAuth tokens look healthy.
connector_health.empty_sync_errors: No connectors are currently in a sync-error state.
connector_health.recent_failures_subtitle_suffix: audit events in the last {{days}} days.
connector_health.empty_recent_failures: No proactive token refresh failures in the last {{days}} days.

connector_attention.open_tenant_title: Open the tenant's Connectors page in a new tab
connector_attention.retry_refresh_title: Force an OAuth token refresh now
connector_attention.retry_unsupported_title: {{provider}} does not support OAuth refresh from this panel
connector_attention.send_email_title: Re-issue the reconnect email to tenant admins (bypasses the 24h throttle)

expiring_soon.title: Expiring soon
expiring_soon.empty: No connectors are expiring within the next {{hours}}h.

stuck_outbox.title: Stuck connector messages
stuck_outbox.subtitle: Outbox events the drain worker has parked. Failed rows still have automatic retries scheduled; dead-letter rows have hit max_attempts and need manual intervention. Retry now requeues the row immediately; Mark resolved archives a dead-letter row so it stops surfacing here.
stuck_outbox.empty: No outbox events are stuck. The drain worker is keeping up across all tenants.
stuck_outbox.retry_now_title: Reset status to pending and trigger the drain worker on the next cycle
stuck_outbox.mark_resolved_title: Archive this dead-letter row so it stops appearing here. The original payload stays in the table for forensics.

compliance.confirm_initialize_encryption: Initialize encryption for {{tenant}} on their behalf? This will create an active per-tenant DEK and is recorded in the audit log.

verified_caller.title: Verified caller health
verified_caller.subtitle: Cross-tenant view of verified outbound caller IDs that are about to expire, already expired, or were revoked by Twilio. Sourced from the weekly health scheduler.
verified_caller.load_failed: Failed to load verified caller health: {{error}}
verified_caller.empty: No verified callers are flagged as expiring, expired, or revoked. All tenants are healthy.
verified_caller.no_expiry: No expiry timestamp available — typical for revoked callers.
verified_caller.sort_aria_asc: Sort by days remaining, currently ascending (most urgent first). Click to toggle.
verified_caller.sort_aria_desc: Sort by days remaining, currently descending (least urgent first). Click to toggle.
verified_caller.confirm_reissue: Re-issue alert email + in-app notification for {{phone}} to {{tenant}}?
verified_caller.send_alert_title: Send the verified-caller alert email to the tenant's admins again, even if one was already sent this week
verified_caller.all_bounced_title: Most recent alert ({{time}}) bounced for every recipient — no admin actually received it.
verified_caller.most_recent_dispatch_title: Most recent dispatch ({{source}}): {{sent}} delivered, {{bounced}} bounced, {{failed}} failed, {{skipped}} skipped.

token_health.title: Connector token health
token_health.subtitle: Live OAuth token status across tenants. Refreshed every {{minutes}} minutes by the background sweep.
token_health.empty: No OAuth-style connectors are currently configured across tenants.
token_health.long_subtitle: Last refresh and next expiry per OAuth connector. Tokens expiring within {{hours}}h are flagged; the worker sweeps every ~{{minutes}}m and a row badges as "stale" after {{cycles}} missed cycles.
token_health.empty_no_oauth: No OAuth connectors enabled across tenants yet.
token_health.empty_no_filter_match: No connectors match the current filter.
token_health.stale_pill_title_one: Worker has missed at least {{count}} refresh cycle for this connector
token_health.stale_pill_title_other: Worker has missed at least {{count}} refresh cycles for this connector
token_health.decrypt_failed_title: One or more token tracking fields failed to decrypt — check encryption keys

retention.subtitle: Daily worker keeps the partitioned call_events table inside its {{days}}-day retention window and pre-creates next month's partition.
retention.empty_partitions: No partitions found. The scheduler may not have run yet.
retention.empty_runs: No retention cycles have been recorded yet.
retention.last_failed_banner: Last cycle failed at {{time}}. Check server logs for

integrations_panel.title: OAuth Integration Credentials
integrations_panel.subtitle_suffix: environment variables. No secret values are shown — only whether they are set.
integrations_panel.missing_explainer: Tenants will see a "not configured" message when they try to connect these providers. Set the listed environment variables and restart the server.
integrations_panel.blocked_demand_one: {{count}} tenant-by-provider signal of demand on missing providers (a tenant blocked on two providers counts twice). Each row's blocked attempts badge shows tenants who tried to connect but hit "OAuth not configured" — wire those credentials first.
integrations_panel.blocked_demand_other: {{count}} tenants-by-provider signals of demand on missing providers (a tenant blocked on two providers counts twice). Each row's blocked attempts badge shows tenants who tried to connect but hit "OAuth not configured" — wire those credentials first.
integrations_panel.active_title_configured: {{enabled}} tenant(s) currently enabled; {{attempted}} have ever connected
integrations_panel.active_title_unconfigured: {{enabled}} tenant(s) had this enabled before credentials were removed; {{attempted}} have ever attempted
integrations_panel.blocked_attempts_title: {{count}} tenant(s) tried to connect but were blocked because the server's {{vars}} environment variable(s) weren't configured. Recorded from connector.oauth_attempt_blocked audit events.

support_inbox.banner_failed_title_one: {{count}} ticket with initial-send email delivery errors
support_inbox.banner_failed_title_other: {{count}} tickets with initial-send email delivery errors
support_inbox.banner_failed_explainer: The platform team has been alerted. Check SMTP configuration and the routing destinations below.
support_inbox.banner_reply_title_one: {{count}} ticket with admin reply delivery errors
support_inbox.banner_reply_title_other: {{count}} tickets with admin reply delivery errors
support_inbox.banner_reply_explainer: An outbound admin reply failed to deliver. Auto-retries run in the background; persistent failures raise an operations alert. Open the ticket to see the failed reply and re-send manually.
support_inbox.banner_hard_bounce_focus: Use the “Hard bounces only” filter to focus on permanently undeliverable addresses.
support_inbox.bounced_subtitle: Addresses that have produced at least one hard bounce on an outbound reply. Use this list to clean records, contact users via another channel, or suspend tickets that can’t be answered by email.
support_inbox.alerted_title: Ops was paged about this address at {{time}}
support_inbox.clear_alert_title: Drop the dedup row so the next bounce on this address re-pages ops
support_inbox.unsuppress_title: Remove this address from the suppression list so future replies attempt delivery again.
support_inbox.suppress_title: Stop every future support send to this address until an admin unsuppresses it.
support_inbox.unsubs_count_one: {{count}} address on the support opt-out list
support_inbox.unsubs_count_other: {{count}} addresses on the support opt-out list
support_inbox.unsubs_subtitle: Recipients who clicked the unsubscribe link or sent a one-click opt-out header. Outbound support replies skip these addresses automatically.
support_inbox.resubs_subtitle: Addresses that came off the opt-out list. Useful for sanity-checking "I thought I asked to stop" complaints.
support_inbox.badge_permanent_failure_title: Hard SMTP failure (5xx, address rejected, mailbox full, …) — won't retry. Investigate the recipient address before resending manually.
support_inbox.badge_logged_dev_title: No SMTP delivery — reply was logged to the server console (development mode).
support_inbox.stop_auto_retries_title: Stop the background scheduler from auto-retrying this reply. Use after you've already replied to the customer through another channel.
support_inbox.permanent_classification: Classified as a permanent SMTP failure — the background scheduler will not auto-retry this reply. Use “Retry send” above only after fixing the recipient address.
support_inbox.wont_retry_long: Won’t retry — recipient address was permanently rejected. Fix the address (or reply to the customer through another channel) before resending manually.
support_inbox.reply_helper: Sent via the same SMTP path. Customer replies thread back automatically.
support_inbox.reply_sent_fail: Reply recorded, but email delivery failed.
